cross_references.label: Constitutional foundation for exculpatory evidence disclosure — § 1054.1(e) codifies Brady in California
Brady extended to impeachment evidence — prosecution must disclose benefits given to witnesses
Reciprocal defense disclosure obligations — defense must disclose witnesses and expert reports it intends to call
Enforcement mechanisms for § 1054.1 violations — sanctions, continuance, exclusion, dismissal
Work product protection — limits prosecution's disclosure obligations for trial preparation materials
Pitchess motion — officer personnel records; supplemental discovery mechanism for police witness credibility
New trial motion — Brady violation that is material is ground for new trial
Motion to dismiss — Brady violation at preliminary hearing stage can be raised via § 995 in some circumstances
Mandatory reporter statute — CPS referral documents generated by mandatory reporter reports are subject to § 1054.1 disclosure if exculpatory
